question: Do candle range, outer-wick length, and extension beyond Grimes Keltner channels distinguish subsequent reversion from continuation on MNQ 5m and 15m across all sessions? Sizing means candle anatomy, not position sizing.
sessions: All observed CME Globex minutes excluding daily 16:00-17:00 America/Chicago maintenance; compute channels on all-hours chart, then stratify by event candle open time.
prior_exposure: Registered history has been used in other research; later windows are held apart within this study, not certified globally unseen or prospective.

event_types.wick_only: Extreme strictly beyond same-side completed band but close inside both bands, regardless of open; flag open-outside reclamations separately.
event_types.close_outside: Close strictly beyond the completed upper or lower band.

dual_side_bars: Exclude candles breaching both upper and lower bands.
primary_cohort: Episode starts: qualifying breach whose immediately preceding chart candle did not breach its own same-side band. Require full current/previous bars and indicator warmup. Both wick-only and close-outside classifications are from the completed signal candle.
secondary_cohorts: All qualifying breach candles; overlapping/repeated observations are descriptive
First close outside: close-outside event following a previous close inside same-side band
primary_outcome: First passage 0.5 signal ATR from next-minute open, toward channel versus away, within 60 clock minutes. Minute open resolves known gap order; both extrema hit in the same minute with no opening resolution is ambiguous. Unresolved and ambiguous remain explicit. Primary probability is reversion/(reversion+continuation), conditional on decisive passage.

secondary_outcomes.returns: Signed continuation return from next-minute open to final minute close, normalized by signal ATR; also points; reversion terminal probability excludes exact ties only.
secondary_outcomes.contacts: Frozen signal EMA reach/pass for all events; frozen breached-band return for close-outside only. Never count signal-candle movement.

quality: Only complete chart candles qualify. Require every minute of each outcome horizon, same instrument_id, and no split crossing. Indicators use observed aggregated bars including partial bars but signal/previous bars must be complete; preserve count/contract ID. Reset EMA/TR at rolls and warm up 100 bars. Missing minutes are not forward-filled.
controls: For each episode event, closest earlier nonbreach chart candle in same split within prior 2000 chart bars, same direction of close versus EMA and same time bucket. Match prebar signed EMA change over 5 bars divided by prebar ATR and log prebar ATR. Calipers: slope difference <=0.75, absolute log ATR ratio <=0.35. Minimize slope difference + absolute log ATR ratio; chronological latest wins ties. No future outcome used for selection. Reuse allowed. Controls measure context-adjusted association, not causality.

inference.resampling_unit: Consecutive 5 observed trading-day blocks. One shared block-weight draw for event and control arms; each observation receives its own original-day weight, so every reuse of a control shares its weight. Compare matched pairs with decisive outcomes on both sides, using separate weighted arm means.
inference.minimum_cell: 100 decisive events across at least 50 distinct decisive-event trading dates for a statistical claim
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction of two-sided block-cluster normal-approximation p-values across 16 primary test cells (2 timeframes x 2 event types x 4 extreme-extension bins); descriptive anatomy/session tables are not independent confirmations.

additional_descriptive_outputs: Maximum future reversion and continuation excursions from next-minute open in signal ATR units, for complete horizons only; no signal-candle extrema. Export control dates, unique control counts/reuse and eligibility losses by session.
sweet_spot_criterion: No automatic optimum. A primary extension-bin directional claim needs minimum sample, same direction of probability departure from 50% in development/validation/test, test Holm p<0.05 and pointwise interval excluding 50%. A superior predictive sweet spot also needs same-direction matched-control advantage with CI excluding zero. Secondary anatomy findings remain exploratory without new unseen data.
sensitivity: All-bar versus episode-start and first-close cohorts
ATR sizes normalized by prior-bar ATR as a labeled mechanical-denominator check
boundedness: One fixed indicator, two timeframes, frozen bins and outcomes. No tuned indicator grid, no account sizing, no strategy win-rate or profitability claim. Preserve all zero/sparse/adverse cells. Do not extend search after failed criteria.
deliverables: CSV summary tables and full event/control ledgers
Reproducible research code, protocol and artifact checksum manifest
